##### Project general facts

The Bay Interiors by Missoni is a distinctive waterfront residential development, created by Tomorrow World in collaboration with the iconic Italian fashion house Missoni. Positioned directly along the island’s yacht marina, the project combines contemporary architecture with Missoni’s unmistakable Italian design language, creating a sophisticated setting surrounded by water and open views. The marina-front location gives the residences a strong connection to the coastal landscape, while the thoughtful building orientation is designed to preserve views towards the marina, breakwater, and open sea.

The development is designed as a complete lifestyle destination, with a carefully curated collection of wellness, leisure, and social amenities. Residents can enjoy a beach pool with cabanas and sun loungers, a dedicated dip pool, wellness centre, gym, outdoor and indoor kids’ areas, Zen garden, basketball and pickleball courts, jogging track, outdoor gym, yoga deck, lounge seating, juice bar, and a rooftop sky pool. Together with the landscaped park and seaside deck, these spaces create a resort-inspired environment focused on wellness, recreation, family time, and relaxed waterfront living.

The Bay Interiors by Missoni offers two- and three-bedroom residences designed around generous living spaces, natural light, and direct views towards the sea or city. The interiors reflect Missoni’s Italian design identity, bringing a refined combination of contemporary aesthetics, distinctive detailing, and a sophisticated material palette into the homes. The residences are delivered unfurnished, while kitchens are equipped with Bosch appliances or equivalent, including a hob, hood, refrigerator, oven, and dishwasher, with larger residences also featuring an integrated microwave. The result is a refined canvas where Missoni’s design character meets the flexibility of modern waterfront living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters.

The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities.

Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.
